Beast of Reincarnation

📅 Steam release: 3 August 2026 · GAME FREAK inc.

Confirmed release date, story & systems for Game Freak's one-person, one-dog action RPG

Game Freak's brand-new title: Beast of Reincarnation is an action RPG with a fusion of real-time and turn-based combat. Experience the innovative "one-person, one-dog action RPG" in the beautiful yet harsh world of Beast of Reincarnation.

Confirmed game info Official Steam page

Source verified from the official Steam listing on 2026-07-25. Pre-purchase is live; the game is not out yet.

Official pillars from Steam

These are the systems and story beats Game Freak and Fictions already publish on Steam - not player-tested walkthrough claims.

One-person, one-dog combat

Hybrid combat that combines real-time action with turn-based RPG elements: fight as a unit using Emma's sword abilities while commanding Koo to unleash techniques.

Post-apocalyptic Japan, 4026

Emma, an outcast shunned for her affliction, and Koo, a blighted dog, travel a blighted world, battle Bosses, capture their powers, and aim to defeat the Beast of Reincarnation.

Build your loadout

Customize playstyle with skill trees, gear, and spirit stones - including ranged, stealthy, and aggressive loadouts.

PC system requirements

Steam currently lists Windows-only support, full controller support, 45 GB storage, and SSD required.

  • Minimum GPU: GTX 1070 / RX 580 (8 GB)
  • Recommended GPU: RTX 3060 / RX 6700 XT (12 GB)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Storage: 45 GB SSD
See full minimum & recommended specs →

Also confirmed on Steam

  • Single-player
  • Full controller support
  • Steam Achievements
  • Steam Cloud
  • Adjustable Difficulty
  • Family Sharing

Genres listed: Action, Adventure, RPG. Languages include full audio for English and Japanese.
